evidence: 84 focused security tests passed in reviewer run
42 focused persistence/concurrency tests passed in reviewer run
190 focused contract/gate tests passed in reviewer run
provider free-form secret leakage pattern reproduced

findings.evidence: Independent probe placed a temporary executable first in PATH and observed a marker file created by its execution.
findings.recommendation: Require an injected runner-issued capability and immutable allowlisted executable metadata; remove ambient PATH/default subprocess execution.
findings.title: Local readiness probe executes PATH-controlled binaries without sandbox capability

findings.evidence: Provider metadata under an innocuous key preserved a credential-assignment pattern in its string value.
findings.recommendation: Reject or redact credential assignments in arbitrary string values, not only sensitive keys.
findings.title: Provider metadata redaction misses free-form secret assignments

findings.evidence: V2 path obtains lease and runs adapter without FleetRunStore.use before side effects; final commit fencing is too late.
findings.recommendation: Call use with immutable lease token immediately before provider/adapter execution and fail closed on stale lease.
findings.title: Orchestrator does not fence lease immediately before adapter execution

findings.evidence: Dependency can change after ready_ids and before claim_many; claim_many does not revalidate dependency completion under the same lock.
findings.recommendation: Move dependency barrier evaluation into the locked claim selection.
findings.title: Dependency readiness has a ready_ids to claim_many TOCTOU race

findings.evidence: A passed GateResult with owner/decision/evidence/reports is accepted without human gate, scope, run, digest or freshness.
findings.recommendation: Require HumanVerificationGate for human-required gates and evaluate current run/scope/digests/freshness.
findings.title: Ordinary GateResult can bypass HumanVerificationGate

findings.evidence: Independent probe: gate recorded for one run/scope returns allows without expected scope/run inputs; evaluate has no such parameters.
findings.recommendation: Require expected current run and canonical scope in evaluate/allows and fail closed on mismatch.
findings.title: HumanVerificationGate stored scope and run are not checked against operation

findings.evidence: Unsupported objects invoke attacker-controlled repr during persistence/projection.
findings.recommendation: Reject unsupported objects; accept only exact JSON-safe types.
findings.title: Observability serializes arbitrary objects through repr

findings.evidence: cwd can be replaced between resolve/validation and Popen; executable pinning exists but cwd pinning does not.
findings.recommendation: Pin/recheck cwd identity immediately before execution or require a real platform sandbox for hostile actors.
findings.title: Sandbox cwd is path-validated but not descriptor-pinned

findings.evidence: Expired leases can block overlapping path reuse even though claim_many treats them as available.
findings.recommendation: Filter occupancy by active expiry under the same clock/lock or move path selection into store claim.
findings.title: Expired leases remain in scheduler path occupancy

findings.evidence: claim computes expiry before _mutate lock; claim_many computes time under lock, creating inconsistent lease duration/fencing.
findings.recommendation: Compute now/expiry inside the locked mutation callback.
findings.title: Single-task claim computes expiry before acquiring store lock

findings.evidence: Legacy from_dict boundaries accept unknown fields and drop them, unlike strict V2 parser.
findings.recommendation: Reject unknown fields or preserve under explicit versioned extensions.
findings.title: Legacy parsers silently discard unknown fields

findings.evidence: command plus exit_code=0 is accepted without executor provenance, output/artifact digest, scope or freshness window.
findings.recommendation: Require executed-evidence provenance, bounded output/digest, scope and freshness for gate authorization.
findings.title: Evidence record can be accepted without execution provenance or freshness

findings.evidence: Two otherwise identical records without timestamp receive different now timestamps.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit timestamp or inject a clock at orchestration boundary.
findings.title: Missing evidence timestamp uses wall clock and breaks deterministic serialization

findings.evidence: Misspelled policy requirements are stored but ignored during evaluation.
findings.recommendation: Reject unknown requirement names or define versioned extensions.
findings.title: GatePolicy accepts unknown requirement keys silently

notes: Findings are blockers for formal G1/G2-G6 progression.
No human approval or release PASS is implied.
